Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No 101/2018 dated 12.4.2018 registered at Police Station Mundi, District Khandwa (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 366A,376(2)(n),376(2)(cha), 323, 506 of IPC and 5L/6, 5N/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 28/02/2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, on 11/04/2018 17 years and 9 months old prosecutrix's father lodged FIR about missing of his daughter since 11/04/2018.
When despite search she could not be traced, FIR was registered.
Prosecutrix on her own came back to her home on 21/02/2025.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
3. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix and applicant were having love affair and prosecutrix was almost NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17015 2 MCRC-15037-2025 verge of 18 years.
She on her own had gone with the applicant who is her cousin.
They stayed together almost for a period of more than 6 years and entered into wedlock.
No offence of rape /

sentences.text: aggravated penetrative sexual assault is made out.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including material available on record, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Bhanwar Singh @ Golu be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C./Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S., 2023.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE S /-
